description: Land Title Settlement Department - Claims to property of Intestate in Moratuwa D/S Division, and other properties

The content includes detailed land descriptions with cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and certificate of title numbers, all of which are characteristic of land-related administrative matters.
